related_questions.question: What do I do if I test positive for COVID?

text_blocks.snippet: If you test positive for COVID-19, immediately contact your healthcare provider to discuss your situation and potential treatment options. Stay home, rest, and stay hydrated, managing symptoms with over-the-counter medications. Monitor your symptoms closely, and if they worsen, seek immediate medical attention by calling 911 and informing them you have COVID-19 and are experiencing emergency warning signs like difficulty breathing or chest pain.
snippet_highlighted_words: immediately contact your healthcare provider to discuss your situation and potential treatment options

list.title: 1. Contact your healthcare provider:
list.snippet: Inform them of your positive test result and discuss your symptoms and any underlying health conditions. They may recommend specific treatments or medications.

list.title: 2. Isolate at home:
list.snippet: Stay home and avoid contact with others to prevent further spread of the virus.

list.title: 3. Rest and hydrate:
list.snippet: Get plenty of rest to allow your body to recover. Drink lots of fluids to stay hydrated.

list.title: 4. Manage symptoms:
list.snippet: Over-the-counter medications like acetaminophen or ibuprofen can help manage fever, headache, and other symptoms.

list.title: 5. Monitor your symptoms:
list.snippet: Keep a close watch on your symptoms and note any worsening. Seek immediate medical attention if you experience severe symptoms like difficulty breathing, persistent chest pain, or new confusion.

list.title: 6. Follow public health guidelines:
list.snippet: Adhere to any isolation and quarantine guidelines issued by your local health authorities.
